'''Gravak'k''' was an enormous [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] that was under study by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the ''[[Gray Secant]]'' research vessel. It was contained in a [[Icefall Cavern|cave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] until it was released and [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gravak'k appears as one of the World Bosses that are added to the planet Ilum during the Relics of Gree, a recurring World Event in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
